product_metadata.title: Madison Park Serene 100% Cotton Bath Towel Set Luxurious Floral Embroidered Cotton Jacquard Design, Soft and Highly Absorbent for Shower, Multi-Sizes, Blue
features: Add a touch of elegance to your bathroom decor with our Madison Park Serene Embroidered Cotton Jacquard 6 Piece Towel Set
These cotton towels feature a jacquard leaf pattern with a floral embroidered hem, and color contrast piping details to create a beautiful and sophisticated look
This cotton towel set is also OEKO-TEX certified, meaning it does not contain any harmful substances or chemicals, ensuring quality comfort and wellness
Set includes: 2 Bath Towels: 27"W x 52"L, 2 Hand Towels: 16"W x 28"L, 2 Fingertip Towels: 12"W x 18"L
Care Instructions: Machine Washable. New towels tend to lint at first but after several washes, lint will diminish. Towels should be washed separately to minimize lint
description: Add a touch of elegance to your bathroom decor with our Madison Park Serene Embroidered Cotton Jacquard 6 Piece Towel Set. These cotton towels feature a jacquard leaf pattern with a floral embroidered hem, and blue contrast piping details to create a beautiful and sophisticated look. This cotton towel set is also OEKO-TEX certified, meaning it does not contain any harmful substances or chemicals, ensuring quality comfort and wellness. Highly absorbent and incredibly soft from its medium weight terry loop construction, this towel set is also machine washable for easy care for the perfect addition to any bathroom. Set includes: 2 standard 27x52" bath towels, 2 standard 16x28" hand towels, and 2 standard 12x18" fingertip towels.
